title: Give — Baker Road Baptist Church
metaDescription: Three ways to give to Baker Road Baptist Church in Baytown: online, in person on Sunday morning, or by mail.
headline: Three ways, all of them simple.
intro: If you are visiting, please skip this page. Giving is for people who call Baker Road home.

sections.note: “For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.” — Matthew 6:21

items.title: On Sunday morning
items.body: Envelopes are available for cash or checks.

items.title: Send a check
items.body: Make it payable to Baker Road Baptist Church. 900 W. Baker Road, Baytown, Texas 77521.

sections.heading: Why we give at all
sections.body: God is generous, and he calls us to be generous too. What we do with what we have been given says a great deal about the condition of our hearts. Every dollar given here funds the work of this church: the teaching, the children's ministry, the care of members in hard seasons, the missionaries we support, and the building on Baker Road that this congregation has paid for since 1978.
